resting_reference.notes: Resting energy is an estimate for healthy adults. Activity multipliers use 2024 Compendium MET values as intensity anchors and are scaled against the actor-specific resting estimate for simulation evidence; they are not direct calorimetry.

references.mifflin_st_jeor: Mifflin MD et al. Am J Clin Nutr. 1990;51:241-247. PMID 2305711.
references.compendium: Herrmann SD et al. 2024 Adult Compendium of Physical Activities. J Sport Health Sci. 2024. PMID 38242596.
references.selected_anchors: Eating sitting 1.5; showering 2.0; moderate walking about 3.5; vigorous resistance training about 6.0; punching bag 5.8; sparring 7.8; obstacle/boot-camp work 5.0; general yoga/mobility about 2.3.
